intuition_en: 1-hour reversal: very short-term mean-reversion signal. Captures micro-bounce after hourly price drops.
intuition_zh: 1小时反转：超短期均值回归信号。捕捉小时级价格下跌后的微反弹。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Positive direction: formula pre-inverted. Higher value = larger 1h drop, expecting immediate bounce.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 正向：公式已预取反。值越大=1小时跌幅越大，预期立即反弹。
known_limitations_en: Very noisy at 1h horizon. High false-positive rate. Diagnostic probe — may be too short for reliable signal.
known_limitations_zh: 1小时视野噪音很大。假阳性率高。诊断探针——可能太短，不适合作为可靠信号。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 1 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
horizon_notes_zh: 回溯窗口：1根K线。评价覆盖1h/4h/24h/72h视野。
status_explanation_en: Status: DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE. Diagnostic probe — not yet promoted to active signal.
